question: Can a trusted external token quota plus llm-d priority create an enforceable preference while overage and Batch work continue?

test_design.percentile_policy: Per-run request percentiles; policy summaries are medians of three run percentiles. Requests were not pooled across blocks.

no_quota.behavior: Forward every request at standard priority.

classifying_quota.behavior: Give work inside the trusted token budget higher priority and forward overage at standard priority.

blocking_quota.behavior: Give work inside the trusted token budget higher priority and reject overage.
blocking_quota.latency_interpretation: The successful-request percentile excludes classifier rejections and cannot represent all offered work.

supported_claim: A trusted external quota classifier plus llm-d priority created measurable preference for in-budget work while overage and Batch work continued.
claim_boundary: This one-replica, fixed-shape composition test does not establish dedicated capacity, a provisioned-throughput guarantee, universal token weights, or a production service-level objective.
